records.title: GREAT Scholarships 2026 — University of Edinburgh (Ghana, Mexico and Thailand)

validation.notes: Awarding body for this record is The University of Edinburgh (in partnership with the British Council / GREAT Britain Campaign). Identity proven on the official Edinburgh Registry Services page for GREAT Scholarships 2026, which names Thailand, Mexico and Ghana exactly as the record title does. The asset is the University-wide horizontal crest + wordmark ('THE UNIVERSITY of EDINBURGH') served from the University's own Drupal theme image directory on ed.ac.uk; it is the same asset used in the header of the official scholarship page itself (registryservices.ed.ac.uk .../great renders src="/themes/upstream/wpp_theme/images/logo.png"). Downloaded and visually inspected: 831x199 PNG, black-on-transparent full lockup. Rejected sibling uoe-logo-centred-black.png (144x144, favicon-sized square badge).

source.publisher: The University of Edinburgh, Registry Services (Scholarships and Student Funding)
source.raw_extract: In partnership with the British Council and the GREAT Britain Campaign, The University of Edinburgh is offering 3 scholarships to students in Thailand, Mexico and Ghana, applying for one-year postgraduate courses.

validation.notes: Taken from the official admissions page's own masthead logo element: ![Logo Barcelona School Of Economics](/_nuxt/logo_header.yFf_O8dp.svg). Served from bse.eu, the Barcelona School of Economics' own domain (not a shared CDN, not a department subdomain). records.title: CERN Doctoral Student Programme

validation.notes: CERN is the awarding organisation, so the CERN corporate logo is the correct official brand mark. Asset lives in CERN's own WordPress theme public image directory on home.cern, alongside logo-white.svg which is the logo actually rendered in home.cern's footer 'CERN Logo' block. logo-blue.svg is the colour counterpart (fill #0033A0, CERN blue), verified 200 image/svg+xml 5026 bytes and rendered/visually inspected as the CERN ring-and-wordmark logo. Transparent background, so it renders correctly on a white card. Transparency of provenance: I could not find an HTML page on home.cern that references logo-blue.svg by name (home.cern, /press/media-kits, /about, /what-is-cern all reference only logo-white.svg); it is an unreferenced sibling of the in-use footer logo, not a stray third-party or department asset. careers.cern serves the reversed white variant of the identical artwork.

examined: https://careers.cern/programmes/doctoral-studentship (shard official_source_url) - fetched; footer logo block serves cern-white.svg, whose SVG group is explicitly id="logo cern filaire" but which is white-on-transparent
https://home.cern/ - fetched; footer 'CERN Logo' block references https://home.cern/wp-content/themes/cern/public/images/logo-white.svg
https://home.cern/press/media-kits - fetched; CERN70 media kit only, no plain logo asset
https://careers.cern/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/logo-menu.svg - fetched; 61x60 careers.cern site-branding mark, not the full CERN corporate logo
